heading: top-center
name: 置中標題組＋直向小標籤卡片輪播＋分隔線
desc: 上方置中的標題組，下方一次露出四個項目的輪播，每個項目左側有旋轉成直向的小標籤、方形圖片與標題，項目之間以直向分隔線隔開；下方置中箭頭與頁碼。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方置中放標題組；標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略。標題組下方是多個項目橫向排列的輪播，對齊頁面內容寬度，一次露出四個等寬項目，不露出下一個項目；相鄰項目之間有直向分隔線。每個項目無外框：左側是一行旋轉成直向的小標籤，和圖片左緣之間幾乎沒有間隔，上緣與圖片上緣齊平；小標籤右邊是方形圖片，約佔項目寬度的六成多；圖片下方靠左放標題（可多行），文字過長時截斷。輪播下方置中放一組控制：左箭頭按鈕、目前頁與總頁數的頁碼（中間以一條短橫線連接）、右箭頭按鈕，兩顆箭頭分在頁碼兩側，和頁碼之間各隔一段明顯的距離，不聚成一小組；點箭頭一次切換一整頁的項目，不自動播放。
mobile: 標題組維持置中在上方。輪播改為一次露出一個項目，左側對齊頁面內容寬度，右側延伸到畫面邊緣，露出下一個項目的一部分並被畫面右緣裁切；可用手指左右滑動切換。項目內結構不變，直向小標籤與項目之間的直向分隔線保留。控制列的左箭頭靠左、右箭頭靠右，頁碼置中，點箭頭一次切換一個項目。

en.name: Centered heading group + carousel of items with vertical labels and dividers
en.desc: A centered heading group above a carousel showing four items at a time; each item has a label rotated to read vertically on its left, a square image and a title, with vertical dividers between items. Arrows and a page counter sit centered below.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, centered; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description and button below; omit them when there is no content. Below the heading group is a carousel of multiple items arranged horizontally, aligned to the page content width, showing four equal-width items at a time without revealing the next item; there is a vertical divider between adjacent items. Each item has no frame: on its left is a label rotated to read vertically, sitting almost directly against the left edge of the image, with its top aligned to the top of the image; to the right of the label is a square image taking a little over six tenths of the item's width; below the image, aligned left, is a title (may wrap to multiple lines), truncated when the text is too long. Below the carousel, centered, place a set of controls: a left arrow button, a page counter showing the current page and the total number of pages (joined by a short horizontal line), and a right arrow button; the two arrows sit on either side of the page counter, each separated from it by a clear distance rather than packed tightly into a small group; clicking an arrow switches a full page of items at a time, with no autoplay.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The heading group stays centered at the top. The carousel changes to show one item at a time, aligned to the page content width on the left and extending to the screen edge on the right, revealing part of the next item cropped by the right edge of the screen; items can be switched by swiping left and right. The structure inside each item is unchanged, and the vertical labels and the vertical dividers between items are kept. In the controls, the left arrow is aligned left, the right arrow is aligned right and the page counter is centered; clicking an arrow switches one item at a time.
